personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, relies on proven methods, and is cautious about unfamiliar ideas. They may be flexible in the moment but often struggle with organization, planning ahead, and meeting deadlines consistently. In moral dilemmas, they usually respond with strong empathy and a desire to keep everyone comfortable, but anxiety and rumination can make it hard for them to decide quickly or feel certain about the outcome. In group discussions, they speak in a balanced, approachable way, listen carefully, and try to soften disagreements, though they may become visibly uneasy when tension rises.
